easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Lagrella until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
